text:
maria: Sketch idea 1 propose reducing left nav to three anchors: Projects, Model hub, Observability. Other items become contextual flyouts. Goal: declutter and make external links stable. Thoughts?

sam: Leaning yes. Biggest worry: breadcrumbs must remain deterministic for copy/paste.

lina: Totally. Breadcrumbs should show the full resource path (Org > Project > Model > Versions) even if nav label is compact. That keeps automation and permalinks reliable.

alex: Agree. Also: standardize on canonical full-path URLs (no hash routing) and use query params for stable view state. Keep hashes only for ephemeral UI toggles.

maria: Example canonical urls I mocked: `https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/projects/zephyr/models/zephyr-7b?panel=metrics` and ephemeral states like `#inspector=open`.

ethan: A11y: when groups collapse, keyboard focus order must follow logical headings and breadcrumbs. Flyouts need aria-live announcements when opened and focus trapping when interactive.

sam: UX question 1 clicking a subitem inside a collapsed group: expand then navigate, or navigate keeping groups collapsed? Which preserves context?

lina: Navigate directly (keep collapsed) to preserve vertical real estate. But briefly highlight the parent group or show a tiny helper toast: "Found under Model hub" and use `aria-live=polite`.

alex: Migration: support legacy hash routes for a 6-month window. Build a router shim that maps old `#/m/abc` patterns to canonical paths and logs instances.

maria: Cost to maintain mapping?

ethan: Low initially. Log unmatched legacy routes for 30d, add telemetry flag `legacy_route_handled=true` when shim runs so we can track coverage and errors.

prod-bot: deploy-preview created: preview/compact-sidebar-v1 at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-sidebar-v1 includes routing shim and breadcrumb tests.

sam: I'll run an a11y sweep on the preview tomorrow. Checklist: 1) focus order 2) screenreader announcements 3) link text clarity 4) keyboard expand/collapse.

lina: Copy tweak: use "Model hub" instead of "Models" when compact. Ensure breadcrumbs use resource titles not UI labels.

maria: Good. Bookmark policy question: should bookmarks include panel UI state? Pros: reproducible view. Cons: brittle with UI changes.

alex: Prefer minimal bookmarks: canonical path + stable query params (e.g., `?eval=123`). Avoid serializing ephemeral UI. Publish supported query keys so external tools can rely on them.

sam: For programmatic redirects (legacy -> canonical), after navigation call `focus()` on main heading and set `document.title` so screen reader users remain oriented.

maria: Next steps: 1) push preview to design + a11y 2) sam to run accessibility pass 3) eng to add legacy route telemetry 4) product to publish query param contract. I'll post updated mocks and a screenshot soon. :sparkles:

ethan: I'll prototype aria-live announcements for flyouts.

alex: I'll draft the route migration doc (mapping table + deprecation timeline) and share back here.

prod-bot: preview build passed e2e checks (3/3).
